content: Abraham e-maidgi bangud gusad. Neguev-nebaganba nade gusad. Gerar-neggweburgi megidapid. We-neggweburde Cades, degi, Shur, amar-negabargi siid.
Agi Abraham maigua, sogsagusad, e-ome-Sara, e-bunye. Gerar-neggwebur-e-rey-Abimelec, Sara-nikuega Saraʼbina gochad.
A-mutikidba, Bab-Dummad Abimelecʼse gabgi nonikid, ega sognonikid: —Be we-ome-sealid-ular, be burgo. Ar we-omede sui nikad.
Ar Abimelec amba yoo Saraʼse gorsoggu, Abimelec Bab-Dummad-abin sogded: —Dummadye, ¿ar bede dule-neg-oakalossulid oburgoye be sogde?
Ar Abraham-sunnad anga sogsad: We-ome, an-bunye. Degine, omegwa anga sogsamogad: We-machered, an-susye. Ar degisoggu, gwen ichakwa-binsasulidgi an ibmar imaksad. Ibmar-isgana an imaksasulid.
Bab-Dummad Abimelecʼga gabgi sogsad: —An nue be-wisid, ichakwa-binsasulidgi be imaksad. A-ulale, omese-golega an be-imaksasulid, adi, melle be angi noegar.

Ar emigindi, ome e-suiga gannar be berbena. Ar we-machered Bab-Dummad-gayaburba-barsogedsoggu, be-ular Bab-Dummadse goloed, adi, mer be burgwegar. Ar omegwa gannar e-suiga be berbenasulirdi, be, degi, be-gwenadgan burgwemaloed.
Oibosgu, wakudaryalaba Abimelec gwisgusgu, bela e-maiganse gochad, amarga bela sogsad, igi ede gabdaksa. Itosmargua, bela nue-dobe itodmalad.

Geb a-sorbali, Abimelec, Abrahamʼse-gochagu, ega sogded: —¡Emi, be-neg-oakalosad be dake! ¿Ibigi an begi nosa? Emisgi isgued-dummad be angi, degi, an-sordamargi senonigu. Weyob be ibmar imakewilubsulinad.
Abimelec Abrahamʼga sogdebalid: —¿Ar ibiga deyob be imakye be binsaali?
Abraham, Abimelec-abin sogded: —Wegi dule-Bab-Dummad-dobee-nanaed sateye an biendo. Degisoggu, an-ome-ular an-oburgwemaloeddeeye an binsasad.
Ar nabiri, we-omegwa an-bunad. An-bab-e-sisgwad, an-nandi e-nansulid. Deginbali, we-ome, an-omebalid.
Bab-Dummad anga igar-uknonigu: Be-bab-neggi-be-gudiid be naye. Geb an we-omega sogsad: ‘Bia anmar modapile, nue be an-sabele, be sogoye, be an-bunye.’
Geb degine, Abimelec, Abrahamʼga e-ome-Sara gannar uksasunnad. Geb aginbali, Abrahamʼga sibad-wawaadmar, moli-bebe-nikamalad, mai-machergan, degi, mai-omegan, uksabalid.
Abimelec, Abrahamʼga sogdebalid: —Be dake, we an-yala. Bia be megbie be-itolegedba be yar sue.
Saraʼga sogdemogad: —An be-susgala mani-miligwen-aidikue (1,000) uksad. We-mani dule-beba-gudidimalad-asabin be oyogo, adi, oyogega bedi gwen nossurye. Dule-wargwensaale gege begi sunnasur sunmaked.
Geb degine, Abraham Bab-Dummadse goted, geb Bab-Dummad Abimelec-onugusad, degi, e-ome-onugusbalid. Deginbali, e-maimar-omegan-onugusbalid, adi, nabir sunna mimmi-bake gumalagar.
Ar ade, Abraham-e-ome-Sara-ulale, Bab-Jehová omegan-Abimelec-negginmalad geg mimmi-bakega imaksanad.
